title: Forward high-vol vs low-vol ARITHMETIC-mean ledger vs hold-LINK (audit open question 2 / P4)
author: Research Agent (cloud)
question: Is the arithmetic mean 28-day excess of the top volatility quintile over LINK positive after the 4-leg rotation cost? (the only remaining case for high-vol exposure under an expected-USD objective; X4 found rank/median negative but the discovery arithmetic mean ~equal)
evidence_class: locked forward holdout: outcome periods start at the first Monday after freeze_ts; all post-cutoff (2026-06)
data: Kraken public OHLC 1440; append-only archive closes.jsonl (research sessions run archive.py) merged with a fresh fetch at evaluation; delisted pairs keep their last archived close
universe_rule: usd_vol_24h >= $250k and sigma30 >= 0.5% at snapshot; LINKUSD added as benchmark
decision: every 28 days from t0; vol60 = sd of 60 daily log returns ending at close(t), pairs with vol60 < 0.5% excluded, LINK excluded from baskets; Q5 = top ceil(n/5) by vol60, Q1 = bottom ceil(n/5); equal weight

statistics.q5_net (PRIMARY): mean over periods of (Q5 basket simple return - LINK return - 1.83%) -- ARITHMETIC, the expected-USD decision statistic
statistics.q5_median_asset_minus_link: per-period median asset in Q5 minus LINK (reported beside the mean, per the audit)

multiplicity: one primary statistic (q5_net); q1_net and the spread are descriptive

cost_model.source: REGISTRY A1; P3 measured maker costs will be reported as a sensitivity when available, never replacing the primary

honest_expectation: 13 periods per year; 28-day basket excess sd is large (~15-25%), so MDE after 1 year ~12-20%. Only a large arithmetic edge or a clearly negative one is resolvable within 1-2 years.
not_actionable_note: Spot only. Any verdict is evidence for the live agent, not an instruction; the live X4 veto stays unless the live agent decides otherwise.
